queries.name: E21 drain failure
queries.overview: Washer stops before spin and displays E21; water remains in drum.
queries.observations: Cycle stops after drain phase. Accessible filter appears clear.

queries.name: Slow fill E10
queries.overview: Washer fills slowly and reports inlet error E10.
queries.observations: Little water enters during fill; hose routing is being checked.

queries.name: Unbalanced spin load
queries.overview: Spin speed is not reached with one bulky item in the drum.
queries.observations: Drum tumbles, then slows and reports an unbalanced load.

queries.name: Door seal leak
queries.overview: Water appears at the lower edge of the door during wash.
queries.observations: No leak is seen at rear hoses; visible seal is being inspected.

queries.name: Drain grinding noise
queries.overview: Washer makes a grinding noise during the drain phase.
queries.observations: Filter looks clear and there is no visible external leak.

queries.name: Musty seal odor
queries.overview: A musty odor is present near the door seal after low-temperature cycles.
queries.observations: No water leak is observed; odor is strongest after the cycle.

queries.name: Overfill during intake
queries.overview: Water continues entering beyond the expected fill level.
queries.observations: Test was stopped for safety; record the fill level and stage.

queries.name: Excess suds
queries.overview: Excessive foam is visible in the drum and rinse takes longer.
queries.observations: The selected detergent dose may be above label guidance.

queries.name: New smart-home pairing issue
queries.overview: Smart-home Matter bridge QR onboarding fails on washer registration.
queries.observations: Mobile companion times out during BLE commissioning after a gateway replacement.

queries.name: New accessibility preference issue
queries.overview: Washer accessibility voice-over setting resets after reboot.
queries.observations: Screen-reader spoken labels disappear after restart; user-interface preference does not persist.
